uses.spoken: This thin line of clay marks the end of the dinosaurs.

uses.note: Matched frame-0 plate after the last word. No banner, no video id, no code text.

uses.spoken: It's in a cliff in Italy about a centimeter thick.
Below it, the rock is full of tiny fossil
shells. Above it, almost all of them are gone.
Something huge had hit the Earth
When the asteroid struck sixty-six million years ago,
Their descendants are all around you now:

uses.note: Matched robin opening, second appearance only; allocate a verified distinct source window at assembly. No banner, video id or code text.

uses.spoken: Every bird you have ever seen is a living dinosaur.
Look up. They never really left
the pigeon on the pavement, the robin
in the garden, the gull at the seaside.
